cards.text: The LORD is speaking through Hosea the prophet to the people of Israel (Hosea 4:1), and here He's talking about Ephraim, the kingdom that broke away from Judah (Isaiah 7:17). Ephraim mixes with the nations, and the LORD says, "Ephraim is an unturned cake." Friend, a picture straight from the oven? Now THAT'S my language.

cards.question: Foreigners are eating away at Ephraim's strength. How does Ephraim react?

cards.text: That's your phone at 2 percent while you keep scrolling like it's fully charged. And it gets worse, because even his hair is streaked with gray.

cards.question: Ephraim knows his hair is streaked with gray.

cards.text: Then the LORD says Israel's arrogance testifies against them. Their own pride walks into court and testifies AGAINST them.

cards.question: Israel's own arrogance testifies against them. Despite all this, how do they respond to the LORD their God?

answers.text: They neither return to Him nor seek Him
They return to Him and seek Him
They return to Him for a while

cards.text: So the LORD says Ephraim has become like a silly, senseless dove. Minty, one of my cookie cutter kids, is a dove, so I'm taking this one PERSONALLY.

cards.question: This senseless dove can't settle. Which two nations does Ephraim flutter between?

cards.text: Calling out to Egypt, then turning to Assyria. You know when someone hops between two checkout lines and STILL ends up the last one out the door?

cards.question: Ephraim's people are flapping between nations like birds. As they go, the LORD says He will spread His ___ over them.

cards.text: The LORD says He'll bring them down like birds of the air and chastise them when He hears them flocking together.

cards.question: The LORD says woe to Ephraim's people, for they have strayed from Him and rebelled against Him. Though He would redeem them, they speak ___ against Him.
When Ephraim's people wail upon their beds, they are crying out to the LORD from their hearts.

cards.text: Then the LORD says they slash themselves for grain and new wine, but turn away from Him.

cards.question: Ephraim's people plot evil against the LORD, even though He trained and strengthened their arms.

cards.text: They turn, but not to the Most High. Oh, so NOW the unturned cake wants to turn?

cards.question: Ephraim's people turn, but not to the Most High. What does the LORD say they're like?

cards.text: A bow you can't count on. Baker, that's my oven timer: it says ten minutes and means whatever it feels like.

cards.question: The LORD says the leaders of Ephraim's people will fall by the sword for the ___ of their tongue.

cards.text: And for this, they'll be ridiculed in the land of Egypt. Yes, the same Egypt Ephraim was calling out to.
